messages:
elaine_s: Hi team — heads up: PeakBoard (healthtech) wants a POC next week. They're planning to start on hosted, evaluate latency/cost, then consider Dedicated or Private. Asks: run our 30B variant (they have a custom finetuned tokenizer), estimate pricing for ~50M tokens/mo, confirm KMS support, and fill the security questionnaire. Can we confirm any model/infra blockers?

samir_se: Quick Q — do they have a custom tokenizer model file or just token additions? also what's the average and 95th pct sequence length?

elaine_s: They said avg seq ~1200 tokens, peaks to ~4k. Tokenizer is custom with ~300 extra clinical tokens and some special markers. They can't share weights yet, but can share tokenizer.json and transformer config.

raj_fieldeng: 4k peaks matter. Our 30B quant variant currently validated up to 4096; for reliable 4k+ tails we should provision 8192 context config on the runtime or fallback to non-quant 30B for long requests. Ops/infra notes: we can do a canary on hosted that routes long-context requests to a non-quant variant to avoid OOMs.

nick_security: @elaine_s important: will PHI be processed/stored? If yes we need BAA + Private/VPC discussion. Also need clarification on KMS: do they require customer-managed keys (BYOK) or HSM for key custody? provide security questionnaire asap.

jessica_ae: For pricing, rough hosted estimate for 30B quant: X per 1k tokens for generation, Y for embeddings if used — I'll assemble a range based on 50M tokens/mo and expected 20% generation ratio. Also need concurrency and SLA requirements to size Dedicated pools and give reserved commit pricing.

elaine_s: They'll start with hosted to run latency experiments (95th p95 target) and then may move to Dedicated if cost & latency look good. I'll get sample traffic shape and top 50 prompts.

raj_fieldeng: On compatibility sweep: we should run a tokenizer mapping test + RMSNorm/weight-format check + attention kernel shape validation. If they can share tokenizer.json and model config I can run the sweep in ~48h. If they only share vocab/token additions we can emulate mapping but it's riskier.

samir_se: If weights can't be shared, request ONNX or HF transformers config + tokenizer. Our preprocessor shim can insert a token-mapping layer for renamed tokens. Sample quick test command I've used: 

```
python - <<'PY'
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
print('sample:', t.encode('Patient is allergic to penicillin').tokens)
print('len:', len(t.encode('A'*2000).tokens))
PY
```

samir_se: That will surface tokenization drift and avg tokenization rate.

nick_security: For hosted BYOK: currently partial support — keys are wrapped in our backend KMS. For full customer-controlled HSM you'll need Private deployment. Network reqs: VPC peering or IP allowlist, and audit log retention (they asked 1 year). Please flag PHI requirement to legal.

olivia_legal: I'll prep the standard DPA/BAA + MSA bullet points. @elaine_s please get the PeakBoard legal contact and the filled security questionnaire file — faster if we get it before POC starts.

devops-bot: ticket #SAL-4821 created: peakboard-poc-onboard - checklist: model-sweep, tokenizer-test, pricing-estimate, security-qa. Assignees: @raj_fieldeng, @samir_se. ETA goals set in ticket. :clipboard:

elaine_s: Thanks — action items: samir -> run tokenizer test (ETA 1 business day), raj -> full variant compatibility sweep (ETA 2 business days), nick -> draft security questionnaire answers (ETA 1 day), jessica -> pricing ranges + Dedicated sizing (ETA 1 day). I'll sync back with customer and attach sample prompts. :thumbsup:

raj_fieldeng: FYI, if we need to adjust kernel selection for 8k context it may add ~10-15% cost on hosted due to memory footprint; note that in pricing.

samir_se: ack, will include token-rate delta in results.

nick_security: Also note regulator Qs — if they operate in EU, need data residency options for Private.

elaine_s: Great, I'll update the ticket and cc PeakBoard. Ping me if you need demo creds or a small sample dataset. :eyes:
